name: Omni Tempe Hotel at ASU
positioning: Downtown Tempe hotel steps from Arizona State University's Tempe campus, with a rooftop pool deck and Southwest-style rooms
best_for: Visitors to Arizona State University's Tempe campus
Travelers who want a walkable downtown base near Tempe Town Lake and Mill Avenue

facts.text: The hotel is located steps from ASU's Tempe campus on University Drive and Mill Avenue.
The hotel has an expansive rooftop pool deck with views of the city.
The guest rooms and suites blend modern comfort and amenities with Southwest style.
The 24-hour fitness center is equipped with Peloton bikes and StairClimbers.
The hotel is a base for boutique shopping on Mill Avenue and hiking trails at Papago Park and Tempe Butte.
Dining includes a full-service restaurant, a coffee shop, a rooftop bar and a pool bar and grill.
The American restaurant serves farm-fresh ingredients and craft cocktails.
The hotel has nearly 36,000 square feet of event space for weddings and events.
Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is 4.1 miles from the hotel.

highlights.text: An expansive rooftop pool deck looks out over the city.
Guest rooms and suites blend modern comfort with Southwest style.
Within five minutes' walk of the hotel, guests can hike A Mountain, run along Tempe Town Lake or explore live music venues.
The rooftop pool has private cabanas.
The hotel is a launch point for boutique shopping on Mill Avenue and hiking scenic trails at Papago Park and Tempe Butte.

considerations.text: The hotel sits steps from ASU's Tempe campus, in a university setting.
WhataHotel notes the lively university neighborhood may mean more noise, especially on weekends.
